description: This file defines an extension method for creating a ClusterMembershipSnapshot from a MembershipTableSnapshot, used within Orleans Runtime Membership Service to handle cluster membership data.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshotExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for MembershipTableSnapshot.

methods.name: CreateClusterMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a ClusterMembershipSnapshot from a MembershipTableSnapshot by iterating over its entries and building a new snapshot.
